description: This file defines a utility class AsyncResultHandle used internally for testing asynchronous operations within the Orleans framework. It manages flags and provides waiting mechanisms with timeout support.

classes.name: AsyncResultHandle
classes.description: A class for internal testing that manages asynchronous result handling, including wait mechanisms with timeout.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the handle, clearing exception, result, and flags.

methods.name: WaitForFinished
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until the result is marked as done or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForContinue
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until the continue flag is set or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitFor
methods.description: Core asynchronous wait method that polls checkFlag until true or timeout.
